al.note: Official SOS election data/results index (precinct and statewide files). Unofficial election-night reporting is served from alabamavotes.gov (www2.alabamavotes.gov/electionnight); could not confirm that page's content.

ak.note: Lists unofficial election-night results and links to official results search.

az.note: SOS election-night results info page; links to the live ENR site results.arizona.vote.

ar.note: Links to ENR on arkansas.tally-enr.com. Page notes a transition to a new ENR vendor.

ca.note: Named as the state election results website on official sos.ca.gov voter-guide pages. Direct fetch was blocked by bot protection (Incapsula).

co.note: Results & data landing page. On election night SOS posts the live ENR (Clarity) link on its home page.

ct.note: Directory linking the Elections Management System (electronic results since 2018) and electionhistory.ct.gov.

dc.authority: District of Columbia Board of Elections

fl.authority: Florida Department of State, Division of Elections
fl.note: Page metadata names the Division of Elections' Election Results Reporting System. The body is frame-based, so content was minimal.

ga.note: Results landing page on sos.ga.gov. Live ENR is results.sos.ga.gov (fetched, but its JS app shows no branding); older links go to results.enr.clarityelections.com/GA/.

il.note: Statewide vote totals. Illinois has no statewide unofficial ENR; on election night, counties and election authorities report results.

in.authority: Indiana Secretary of State, Election Division
in.note: Landing page; ENR runs at enr.indianavoters.in.gov.

ia.note: Page loads ('List Elections') but shows no branding, and sos.iowa.gov results pages failed to fetch. SOS press releases say unofficial results are posted via sos.iowa.gov. Needs manual check.

ks.note: Mainly official results (PDF/Excel). Page says unofficial results are available on request.

la.note: Live graphical results app with SOS branding.

me.authority: Maine Secretary of State, Bureau of Corporations, Elections and Commissions
me.note: Results are posted as downloadable files. Maine has no live statewide ENR.

md.note: Official domain, but this page could not be fetched (robots disallowed). Per-election pages such as elections.maryland.gov/elections/2026/index.html did load and link to results. Switched to 2026 elections page, which loaded and links to results.

ma.authority: Secretary of the Commonwealth of Massachusetts, Elections Division
ma.note: Certified results database. Massachusetts has no statewide election-night ENR.

mi.authority: Michigan Department of State (Secretary of State)

mt.note: electionresults.mt.gov redirects here. Page says 2026 general results post after 8:00 pm on Nov 3.

ne.note: Already configured for the Nov 3, 2026 general election.

nv.note: Long-standing SOS 'Silver State Election Night Results' site (described in 2014 coverage). Fetches of this site and nvsos.gov were blocked by bot protection (Incapsula), so content and official link could not be confirmed.

nh.note: Official sos.nh.gov page. New Hampshire has no live statewide ENR.

nj.authority: New Jersey Department of State, Division of Elections
nj.note: Results archive. Election-night unofficial results are reported by county clerks.

nm.note: Already configured for the Nov 3, 2026 general election.

ny.authority: New York State Board of Elections
ny.note: Certified results and archive (results.elections.ny.gov). Election-night unofficial results are reported by county boards (see elections.ny.gov/election-information-0). nyenr.elections.ny.gov could not be confirmed.

nc.authority: North Carolina State Board of Elections
nc.note: Linked from ncsbe.gov/results-data as the Election Results Dashboard.

oh.note: Unofficial election-night results with a NIST 1500-100 XML feed.

ok.note: Official results landing page. Could not confirm the live ENR site (results.okelections.gov/.us).

or.authority: Oregon Secretary of State, Elections Division
or.note: Page says ENR is a service of the Oregon SOS. Its footer text is stale (names former SOS Dennis Richardson), and no link to it was found on sos.oregon.gov. Alternative: https://sos.oregon.gov/elections/Pages/electionhistory.aspx.

pa.note: Linked from the official pa.gov election-data page and named as the returns site in DOS press releases, but direct fetch failed, so I could not confirm it loads.

ri.note: Results landing page. 2026 live results are on electionresults.ri.gov; earlier ones on ri.gov/election/results.

sd.note: Showed 'Testing In Progress' for the Nov 3, 2026 general election.

tn.authority: Tennessee Secretary of State, Division of Elections
tn.note: Unofficial election-night results with SOS branding. Historical results: https://sos.tn.gov/elections/results.

tx.note: SOS results landing page. It links the current ENR app at goelect.txelections.civixapps.com/ivis-enr-ui/races (the old results.texas-election.com did not load). Switched to live ENR app linked from SOS.

ut.note: Official results/historical page. electionresults.utah.gov loads a generic results app, but no Utah branding or official link to it was confirmed.

vt.note: Linked as 'Election Night Results' from sos.vermont.gov.

va.note: Links to ENR on enr.elections.virginia.gov, including Nov 3, 2026.

wa.note: Links to ENR on results.vote.wa.gov / results.votewa.gov.

wv.note: WVSOS election-night reporting runs on Clarity (per WVSOS announcements republished by WV Press). sos.wv.gov results pages could not be fetched to confirm a stable landing link; apps.sos.wv.gov/elections/results covers only 2008-2017.

wi.note: Official/certified results only. Page says Wisconsin has no central unofficial election-night results site; counties and municipalities report.
